invariant: PlantUML's SVG serialization is a backend-wide finalization step: a logical font family equal to Monospaced is emitted as CSS family monospace, and text painted with effective family monospace or Courier has every ASCII space converted to U+00A0 before the DOM serializes it. The conversion depends on the effective emitted font family, whether that family came from the base FontConfiguration or an inline Creole atom.
causal_divergence: Rust recognizes Monospaced as a monospace metric family, so the rejected component checker has matching geometry, but text_render::write_text_element emits the uncanonicalized base family and only receives NBSP text when the Creole parser marked an inline segment as monospace. A style-selected base family Monospaced therefore emits font-family="Monospaced" with literal spaces, while Java's SvgGraphics emits font-family="monospace" with numeric NBSP entities.
planned_change: Centralize Java's SvgGraphics family finalization in text_render::write_text_element. Resolve the effective family from inline style or TextBase, canonicalize logical Monospaced to monospace case-insensitively, and convert ASCII spaces to U+00A0 whenever the finalized family is monospace or Courier. Preserve metrics and layout, which already consume the original family through metric_family, and leave all other family names byte-compatible.
perturbation_axes: logical Monospaced versus CSS monospace versus Courier and unrelated proportional families
base style-selected family versus inline Creole font family
single versus multiple internal spaces and punctuation
component relationship labels versus another renderer using text_render
dpi or explicit scale with renamed labels
scope_boundary: This mechanism owns SVG font-family canonicalization and space serialization in the shared text renderer. It does not alter font metrics, label dimensions, Graphviz topology, style snapshot timing, comparator behavior, baselines, direct SVG emitters outside text_render, or fixture eligibility.
acceptance: The preserved checker_monospaced_lr_dpi input passes diff_one --no-oracle.
Unit tests cover logical Monospaced, Courier, and an unrelated family without changing measured width.
Fresh Java perturbations cover at least two renderers and two independent family/content axes.
The renderer suite and no-oracle product ratchet remain green without family regression.
An independent checker records an accepted verdict at the exact implementation revision.
forbidden_approaches: special-casing component diagrams, checker labels, dpi 100, or known SVG coordinates
changing metrics or layout to address a serialization-only mismatch
changing comparator tolerance, baselines, or fixture eligibility
